desc: leans in, rubs prism in circles with cloth, other hand steadies it

problems: No prism is visible. Without the glass, the hands just hold a crumpled grey lump, so the shot doesn't read as 'polishing a prism' at a glance.
The cloth is dark grey with crumpled, claw-like folds. It reads as a metal gauntlet or a bunch of gloves, not as soft fabric.

The far (steadying) hand at [88.7,-236.1] and the near hand (orbiting around [132,-246]) overlap in one blob, so you can't tell which hand steadies and which rubs. The far arm is mostly hidden behind the torso.
The circular stroke covers about 20 units around a point that isn't on any object, so it looks like the hands are jiggling in the air rather than rubbing a surface.
Lean, standing legs and squint-down gaze are good, feet stay planted, and the colours fit the house look.

for: Tomás rubs a glass prism with a cloth in small circular strokes, leaning toward it, one hand steadying the glass
